repos_data.description: Free, open-source macOS cleaner. CleanMyMac alternative with zero telemetry. Native SwiftUI, scheduled auto-cleaning, Xcode/Homebrew/system...
Transparent macOS disk cleaner — groups files by app, moves to Trash (never permanent). SwiftUI + Liquid Glass, built for macOS Tahoe.

repo_meta_data.description: Mac Sai: the open-source Mac cleaner, optimizer, and malware scanner. A free, Apple-notarized alternative to CleanMyMac, built with Swift 6 and SwiftUI.
